description: Read Lighter perpetual markets and place guarded orders, including the H100 compute-price market.
name: io.github.winter0x/lighter-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Deployment to read: mainnet, testnet, or robinhood. Defaults to mainnet.
environmentVariables.name: LIGHTER_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Sub-account the agent trades from. Read-only tools work without it.
environmentVariables.name: LIGHTER_ACCOUNT_INDEX

environmentVariables.description: API key slot bound to the sub-account, 0 to 254.
environmentVariables.name: LIGHTER_API_KEY_INDEX

environmentVariables.description: API key private key. Full write authority over the account it is bound to, so use a dedicated sub-account.
environmentVariables.name: LIGHTER_API_KEY_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Per-order notional ceiling in USD. Required before any order can be signed.
environmentVariables.name: LIGHTER_MAX_NOTIONAL_USD

environmentVariables.description: Layer-2 chain id bound into every signature. Mainnet uses 304 and testnet 300, so this is only needed on a deployment that publishes none.
environmentVariables.name: LIGHTER_CHAIN_ID

environmentVariables.description: Read-only token for account observation without a signing key.
environmentVariables.name: LIGHTER_READ_ONLY_TOKEN
